description: {Name to be defined} is a mobile and web application designed to help small bakeries manage their inventory, sales and optimize their operations.

title: JobHill
description: Jobhill is a job search platform focused on providing the latest internship and new grad opportunities in the tech industry. Built for helping fellow students from Tec de Monterrey
expandDescription: JobHill is a job board for Tec de Monterrey students to find tech internships and entry-level roles. I built it to simplify the search process by aggregating opportunities into a clean interface with filters for location, company, and job type.

The platform features a 'company-grouped' view, allowing users to see all open roles at specific target employers in one place. Students can also save favorite postings and track their application status through a personal dashboard.
I used Supabase for real-time data syncing and secure authentication, ensuring the dashboard stays updated across all devices while keeping user data private.

title: CrossTalk
description: A 3D music visualizer that uses AI to analyze your playlists and build a personality profile based on your music taste.
expandDescription: CrossTalk is a web app that turns Spotify playlists into an interactive 3D orbital system. By feeding song lyrics and emotional data into Google Gemini, the app creates a personality profile that describes the user through the music they listen to.

At the center of the 3D nucleus is an AI chat interface. This 'core' is grounded in the collective sentiment of the playlist, allowing users to discuss their musical habits and get personalized insights into their own listening patterns.

The team developed the 3D environment to map songs as orbital nodes based on their intensity. The final experience combines music analysis, 3D visualization, and natural language processing to offer a deeper look at the person behind the playlist.

title: Papalote Museum App
description: An iOS app for Papalote Museo del Niño, featuring 3D maps and AR; voted best project among six competing teams.
expandDescription: Developed as part of a 5-person team, this app was selected as the top project by the museum board out of six competing groups for its technical execution and user experience.

We built this app to make museum visits more interactive for kids and families. It features an AR scavenger hunt created with RealityKit, where visitors find and collect virtual cards by interacting with physical exhibits.

The app also uses a custom CreateML model for image recognition, allowing users to point their camera at an exhibit to unlock educational content and track their exploration progress via a Supabase backend.

title: Innovaction Gym Event Dashboard
description: A management dashboard built for Innovaction Gym to handle event scheduling and member attendance.
expandDescription: This was a collaborative project where my team of three developed a central hub for Innovaction Gym to manage their events. We built a calendar interface that replaced their manual scheduling process, making it easier for admins to organize sessions.
I worked on integrating Chart.js to visualize gym data, allowing the staff to see attendance trends and popular event locations through simple, interactive graphs.
The project was built using a React and TypeScript frontend with a Flask and MySQL backend. We also used Clerk to handle secure user sign-ins.

title: GlucoPredict
description: GlucoPredict is a SwiftUI-native iOS app that helps people with diabetes anticipate glucose trends and make smarter meal and insulin decisions through predictive modeling and clinical insights.
expandDescription: GlucoPredict is an iOS health app built for Swift Challenge Fest 2025 that helps people with diabetes stay ahead of their glucose levels. Instead of just tracking data, it uses CoreML to predict future blood sugar trends based on meals, exercise, and insulin doses.

The app was designed to be proactive rather than reactive. Users can log their day-to-day activity and see real-time updates via Live Activities and Widgets, while a Gemini-powered meal planner suggests food optimized for glucose stability.
